title: Keep work core JSON refusals clean when slow warnings are requested
outcome: Implicit JSON output from work core remains a single JSON document even when --warn-slow is supplied without --json.
acceptance: The parsed CLI warning policy suppresses slow-operation warning text for work core operations, whose success and refusal output is always JSON, even with --warn-slow and no --json flag.
A regression covers work core implicit JSON selection while preserving explicit --json suppression, human-facing warning opt-in, and the unchanged MCP/control policy.
The correction changes no operation deadline, refusal code, source-observation predicate, or work authority.
